summary: STRATEX iteration 18 full regression PASS for all P0/P1 features. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases green in 13.5s covering (1) CEO direct-token login Tony@Stratexdrone.com/1111 → role='ceo' + bad-password rejection; (2) Regional Switchboard with KY pinned first, totals (incl. roi_saturation_pct=75.0), 4 states (KY/IN/OH/TN), per-state store_count + scans; (3) Consensus engine — /api/ceo/consensus/recent returns audit list, /inject-variance accepts demo toggle (200); (4) Pilot routes — /api/pilot/calendar lists 4 jobs, /pilot/jobs/{id} returns sheet, /pilot/preflight/{id} returns checklist (200); (5) Fleet Live /api/fleet/live returns drones with lat/lng + altitude + bearing + trail; (6) PDF deliverables — /crown-demo/pdf + /crown-demo/deck.pdf both 200 application/pdf >100KB for contractor token, 401 no-token, 403 for operator role. Frontend (1920x1080): CEO login → /ceo/command works (token persisted to localStorage). /ceo/regional renders both LIST view (KY accordion with BowlingGreen+Lexington+Louisville store cards, IN/OH/TN collapsed) and MAP view (Leaflet ESRI satellite basemap with 14 glowing pins, ROI MET/PENDING legend, size=gross-pipeline), toggle [data-testid=regional-view-list/-map] both work. /ceo/live-map renders Leaflet with active Alpha-08 drone, breadcrumb trail visible on satellite imagery, Active Roster sidebar shows pilot+job context (TRANSIT_TO_JOB, ALT 12.2m, 27 scans). Admin login → /admin/consensus shows Consensus AI Validation Core Audit Trail with 4 authenticated + 6 rejected_variance = 10 total audits, REPLAY (Black Box) buttons on demo rows, filter chips (ALL/AUTHENTICATED/REJECTED_VARIANCE_CRITICAL), trigger action column. Pilot login (pilot@stratex.io) lands on role-aware home with PILOT TABLET/JOB BOARD/FLEET nav. /pilot/preflight/{job_id} renders 'Fleet Autonomous Launch Authorization — STEP 5 — System Pre-Flight Status'. Zero console errors across all flows.

minor.issue: Review request referenced /api/ceo/consensus/audits but actual route is /api/ceo/consensus/recent. No alias. Recommend adding /audits alias for spec parity, or update spec.

Review request referenced GET /api/pilot/jobs (list) and /api/pilot/job-sheet/{id} — actual routes are /api/pilot/calendar (list grouped by date) and /api/pilot/jobs/{job_id} (sheet). Functional equivalents exist; only spec wording differs.

Per-state rows expose store_count + stores_at_roi but NOT a precomputed roi_saturation_pct field — it is exposed only in totals. Frontend currently computes per-state pct from stores_at_roi/store_count (visible as '2/3 ROI' badges). Spec said per-state should expose roi_saturation_pct; consider adding for client simplicity.

action_items: (LOW) Optionally add GET /api/ceo/consensus/audits as alias of /recent, and GET /api/pilot/jobs as flat alias of /calendar.flatMap(jobs), so route names match the operator-facing docs.
(LOW) Optionally expose roi_saturation_pct per state row in /regional/switchboard (currently only in totals).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ceo.py CEO login correctly bypasses MFA path (DEMO_SMS_BYPASS) and issues access+refresh tokens with role='ceo'. must_rotate_password=true is surfaced cleanly so the UI can prompt.
routes/regional.py KY-first sorting via SWITCHBOARD.get_sorted_jurisdictions(local_state) is deterministic. Totals aggregation iterates state_cards once; complexity is O(stores).
routes/pilot.py /pilot/preflight/{job_id} returns the checklist + node status — endpoint shape verified. The seeded calendar exposes 4 jobs for pilot@stratex.io.
routes/pdf.py role enforcement: contractor=200, no-token=401, operator=403 verified end-to-end with live Playwright Chromium boot (~5s cold, fast warm).
FleetLiveMap.jsx Leaflet renders altitude-tinted breadcrumb trail (cyan→blue gradient) — visible in screenshot for Alpha-08; sidebar bound to drone telemetry correctly.
AdminConsensus.jsx audit ledger: filter chips work, REPLAY buttons render only on rows with demo=true (inject-variance entries) — matches Black Box Replay design.
No console errors collected during the full E2E run (CEO login → regional list/map → live map → admin consensus → pilot preflight).
